to.description: the agent's name (on a daemon table; a letter to yourself = your own name, not self or me); give to or box

daemon.description: with to: that agent's daemon folder (default: your own daemon)

box.description: a mailbox folder path, like a letter's reply_to; give to or box

status.description: REQUEST = please do something; DONE = finished; BLOCKED = stuck; NEEDS-USER = only the user can decide; FAILED = gave up; PROGRESS = not done yet, a milestone

title.description: one line that makes sense on its own

what.description: the main text; for REQUEST: what to do and when it counts as done

not_done.description: what is missing or unproven (default none)

decide.description: what the other side or the user must decide (default none)

in_reply_to.description: the letter name you are answering

keep.description: a file name (from your workspace; its folder must exist): append one JSON line for the sent letter to that file ("kept": "sent", letter, sent_at, in_reply_to, from, to, status, title, what, outputs, not_done, decide; a box path is not written). If the file cannot be opened, nothing is sent
